pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiào yú shīfu láikàn nà bàngè shùzì .
pairs.english: Tavi called Master Yu over to look at that half-number.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维叫虞师傅来看那半个数字。

pairs.target: tā dūnxiàlái , méiyǒu tì tā rèn , zhī wèn zhǐ shàng liú le duō dà dìfāng .
pairs.english: She crouched, without identifying it for him, only asking how much space he'd left on the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 她蹲下来，没有替他认，只问纸上留了多大地方。

pairs.target: tā gěi tā kàn , pángbiān xiě zhe " xiàng sān ", xiàmiàn kōng zhe .
pairs.english: He let her see: he had written “looks like three” beside it, with blank space beneath.
pairs.hanzi: 他给她看，旁边写着“像三”，下面空着。

pairs.target: yú shīfu ràng tā bǎ zhè liǎnggè zì huàdiào , lìng xiě zuǒ bàn cún , yòubàn quē , néng kànjiàn de wān zhàozhe miáo .
pairs.english: Master Yu had him cross out those two characters, write instead “left half survives, right half missing,” and trace the visible curve as it was.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅让他把这两个字划掉，另写左半存、右半缺，能看见的弯照着描。

pairs.target: " búshì kǎo nǐ rènzì . "
pairs.english: “This is not testing your reading.”
pairs.hanzi: “不是考你认字。”

pairs.target: tā shuōwán , cháo nà lǎorén zhāoshǒu , wèn yǒuméiyǒu jiù chāoběn .
pairs.english: When she'd finished, she beckoned to the old man and asked whether there was an old copy.
pairs.hanzi: 她说完，朝那老人招手，问有没有旧抄本。

pairs.target: lǎorén shuō wūlǐ huòxǔ yǒu , děi fān , què xiān shēnshǒu mōlemō lièkǒu , shuō zhè bǎnzi zǎo gāi huàn .
pairs.english: The old man said there might be one indoors, but it would take searching; first he reached to feel the crack, saying this board should have been replaced long ago.
pairs.hanzi: 老人说屋里或许有，得翻，却先伸手摸了摸裂口，说这板子早该换。

pairs.target: " zǎo jǐgè yuè yǒurén bào guò ? "
pairs.english: “Did someone report it months ago?”
pairs.hanzi: “早几个月有人报过？”

pairs.target: lǎorén kàn le tā yìyǎn , shuō bào guò , bùzhǐyícì .
pairs.english: The old man glanced at her and said yes, it had been reported, more than once.
pairs.hanzi: 老人看了她一眼，说报过，不止一次。

pairs.target: yú shīfu méiyǒu zhuīwèn shuí méi lǐhuì , zhī jiào bānggōng qǔ liǎngkuài diànmù lái .
pairs.english: Master Yu did not pursue who had ignored it, only asked a helper to bring over two wooden pads.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅没有追问谁没理会，只叫帮工取两块垫木来。

pairs.target: tā dǎkāi mùxiá , náchū de búshì tǎ wéi pàn guò de qíqiǎo qìxiè , érshì yífù zhǎi tiějiā .
pairs.english: She opened the wooden case; what she produced was not the ingenious apparatus Tavi had hoped for, but a narrow iron clamp.
pairs.hanzi: 她打开木匣，拿出的不是塔维盼过的奇巧器械，而是一副窄铁夹。

pairs.target: jiāzi liǎngcè gè zhuāng zhe yípiàn tiě huáng , pángbiān lìng yǒu luógǎn , luógǎn de mùbǐng bèi shǒu mó de fāliàng .
pairs.english: Each side of the clamp carried an iron spring, with a screw alongside; the wooden handle of the screw had been polished shiny by hands.
pairs.hanzi: 夹子两侧各装着一片铁簧，旁边另有螺杆，螺杆的木柄被手磨得发亮。

pairs.target: tā bǎ jiāzi píngfàng , jiǎnchá liǎngpiàn huáng shàng de kè jì , yòu yòng tóngyígè xiǎo fǎmǎ xiānhòu shìleshì .
pairs.english: She laid the clamp flat, checked the marks on the two springs, then tested them in turn with the same little weight.
pairs.hanzi: 她把夹子平放，检查两片簧上的刻记，又用同一个小砝码先后试了试。

pairs.target: liǎngpiàn xiàchén de fúdù chàbùduō , tā réng chóngxīn bǎi le yíbiàn , cái bǎ xiǎo fǎmǎ guàhuí kàoqiáng de huáng xià .
pairs.english: The two deflected by much the same amount; she still reset them once before hanging the small weight back beneath the wall-side spring.
pairs.hanzi: 两片下沉的幅度差不多，她仍重新摆了一遍，才把小砝码挂回靠墙的簧下。

pairs.target: niánqīng bānggōng nálái diànmù , tā jiào tā tuōzhù jiù bǎn xiàbiān , lìng yígè rén fúzhù shàngbiān .
pairs.english: The young helper brought the pads; she told him to support the bottom of the old board while the other person steadied the top.
pairs.hanzi: 年轻帮工拿来垫木，她叫他托住旧板下边，另一个人扶住上边。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wǎng qiáng cè tuì le bànbù , bǎ zhǐ bào zài xiōngqián .
pairs.english: Tavi stepped half a pace back toward the wall side, holding the paper to his chest.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维往墙侧退了半步，把纸抱在胸前。

pairs.target: yú shīfu jiāng tiějiā yí dào lièfèng páng , ràng jiā kǒu tiēzhù liǎngkuài diànmù , xiān bù nǐngjǐn .
pairs.english: Master Yu moved the iron clamp beside the crack, placing its jaws against the two wooden pads without tightening them yet.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅将铁夹移到裂缝旁，让夹口贴住两块垫木，先不拧紧。

pairs.target: tā de liǎngshǒu fēnbié ànzhù liǎngpiàn tiě huáng , jiào niánqīng bānggōng qīngtuī wàicè mùbǐng .
pairs.english: Her hands each pressed one of the two iron springs as she told the young helper to push the outer wooden handle gently.
pairs.hanzi: 她的两手分别按住两片铁簧，叫年轻帮工轻推外侧木柄。

pairs.target: nà mùbǐng bǐ fāngcái nán tuī le , lìng yípiàn huáng què zài yuánxiān nà diǎn xiǎo zhòngwù xià duō wān le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: That handle was harder to push than before, while the other spring bent a little farther under the same small load.
pairs.hanzi: 那木柄比方才难推了，另一片簧却在原先那点小重物下多弯了一点。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe tā de shǒu , méiyǒu shēnshǒu qù mō , yě méi wèn tā jiè le duōshǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi watched her hands, without reaching to touch or asking how much she had borrowed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着她的手，没有伸手去摸，也没问她借了多少。

pairs.target: tā zhīdào zìjǐ ruò zài zhèshí kāikǒu , tā děi fēnshén tīng .
pairs.english: He knew that if he spoke now, she would have to divide her attention to listen.
pairs.hanzi: 他知道自己若在这时开口，她得分神听。

pairs.target: yú shīfu jiào bānggōng xuànjǐn luógǎn , děng tā shuō suǒhǎo le , cái tíngxià nà diǎn jiāohuàn .
pairs.english: Master Yu told the helper to tighten the screw, waited until he said it was locked, and only then ended that small exchange.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅叫帮工旋紧螺杆，等他说锁好了，才停下那点交换。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu lìkè sōngshǒu , yòu kànguò liǎngbiān huīfù hòu de yàngzi , cái chè kāi shǒuzhǐ .
pairs.english: She did not let go immediately, checking the appearance of both sides after recovery, and only then withdrew her fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有立刻松手，又看过两边恢复后的样子，才撤开手指。

pairs.target: tiějiā réng yǎo zhe diànmù , kào de shì yǐjīng suǒzhù de luógǎn .
pairs.english: The iron clamp still gripped the pads, held by the screw that had already been locked.
pairs.hanzi: 铁夹仍咬着垫木，靠的是已经锁住的螺杆。

pairs.target: " xiànzài chāi . "
pairs.english: “Now remove it.”
pairs.hanzi: “现在拆。”

pairs.target: liǎnggè bānggōng tuō zhe bǎnzi , tā qù sōng qiángshàng de jiù dīng , shuǐshēng lǐ hùnjìn le duǎnduǎnde jīnshǔ cā xiǎng .
pairs.english: The two helpers supported the board while she loosened the old nails in the wall; brief metallic scraping mixed with the sound of water.
pairs.hanzi: 两个帮工托着板子，她去松墙上的旧钉，水声里混进了短短的金属擦响。

pairs.target: chāi dào zuìhòu , lièkāi de liǎngbàn méiyǒu sàn , lián nà yìxiǎopiàn cán qī yě liúzài jiāzi xiàmiàn .
pairs.english: At the end of removal the two cracked halves had not separated; even that tiny scrap of paint remained beneath the clamp.
pairs.hanzi: 拆到最后，裂开的两半没有散，连那一小片残漆也留在夹子下面。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhè cái tǔ chū yìkǒuqì .
pairs.english: Only then did Tavi let out a breath.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这才吐出一口气。

pairs.target: yú shīfu táitóu kànjiàn tā , wèn shìbushì lián hūxī dōu wàng le jì .
pairs.english: Looking up, Master Yu saw him and asked whether he'd even forgotten to record his breathing.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅抬头看见他，问是不是连呼吸都忘了记。

pairs.target: tā gǎnjǐn dītóu , què fāxiàn zhǐ jiǎo yǐjīng bèi xiōngqián de yīshang cèng zhòu .
pairs.english: He hurriedly looked down, only to find the corner already crumpled by the clothes across his chest.
pairs.hanzi: 他赶紧低头，却发现纸角已经被胸前的衣裳蹭皱。

pairs.target: " bǎnzi hái zài zhèér , mànmàn jì . "
pairs.english: “The board's still here; take your time recording it.”
pairs.hanzi: “板子还在这儿，慢慢记。”

pairs.target: tā ràng rén bǎ jiù bǎn píng fàngzài gān dì , jiào lǎorén qù zhǎo chāoběn .
pairs.english: She had them lay the old board flat on dry ground and asked the old man to find the copy.
pairs.hanzi: 她让人把旧板平放在干地，叫老人去找抄本。

pairs.target: lǎorén kāisuǒ shí dūnāng , shuō xīn bǎn ruò zhàojiù yàng huà , xiàwǔ yòu děi yǒurén lái wèn hóngxiàn suàn shuí de .
pairs.english: Unlocking the door, the old man muttered that if the new board copied the old pattern, someone would have to come asking again that afternoon whose red line it was.
pairs.hanzi: 老人开锁时嘟囔，说新板若照旧样画，下午又得有人来问红线算谁的。

pairs.target: yú shīfu wèn nǎ dào hóngxiàn , lǎorén zhǐxiàng jiù bǎn zhōngjiān .
pairs.english: Master Yu asked which red line; the old man pointed to the middle of the old board.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅问哪道红线，老人指向旧板中间。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi còujìn kàn , cái fāxiàn shàngmiàn nà céng hóng qī bōluò hòu , dǐxià háiyǒu lìng yìtiáo , wèizhì dī xiē , yánsè àn de xiàng jiù xuè .
pairs.english: Looking closer, Tavi found that beneath the peeling upper layer of red paint was another lower line, its colour dark as old blood.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维凑近看，才发现上面那层红漆剥落后，底下还有另一条，位置低些，颜色暗得像旧血。

pairs.target: tā wèn zhè liǎngtiáo shìbushì dōu yào jì .
pairs.english: He asked whether both these lines should be recorded.
pairs.hanzi: 他问这两条是不是都要记。

pairs.target: yú shīfu shuō dōu miáo , xiān biétì rènhé yìtiáo xiě shàng míngzì .
pairs.english: Master Yu said to trace both, but not yet put a name to either one.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅说都描，先别替任何一条写上名字。

pairs.target: tā zài pángbiān dūnxiàlái , cháo niánqīng bānggōng yào le yíkuài gānjìng de diànbù , tì tǎ wéi yāzhù bèi fēng xiānqǐ de zhǐ jiǎo .
pairs.english: She crouched beside him, asked the young helper for a clean cloth and held down for Tavi the corner lifted by the wind.
pairs.hanzi: 她在旁边蹲下来，朝年轻帮工要了一块干净的垫布，替塔维压住被风掀起的纸角。

pairs.target: zhèhuí tā búyòng bǎ zhǐ bào zài xiōngqián le .
pairs.english: This time he didn't need to hold the paper against his chest.
pairs.hanzi: 这回他不用把纸抱在胸前了。

pairs.target: dìyībǐ luòxià shí , mò hěn wěn , pángbiān de shuǐ què réngjiù yíkèbùtíng dì liú .
pairs.english: As the first stroke fell, the ink was steady, while the water beside him still flowed without a moment's pause.
pairs.hanzi: 第一笔落下时，墨很稳，旁边的水却仍旧一刻不停地流。
